children: Bajaj Finance Limited (NSE:BAJFINANCE) reported September-quarter net profit up 28.8% year on year to ₹6,367 crore and opened a QIP to raise up to ₹11,700 crore. It also raised ₹5,800 crore via warrants issued to Bajaj Finserv.
: Bajaj Finance opened a QIP on November 11 to raise up to ₹11,700 crore, with a ₹992.25 floor price and up to 5% discount. It also raised ₹5,800 crore via warrants issued to Bajaj Finserv.
: Bajaj Finance’s September-quarter net profit rose 28.8% year on year to ₹6,367 crore, while net interest income gained 23.6% to ₹13,335 crore. Assets under management grew 26% to ₹5.85 lakh crore.
: ICICI Securities named Bajaj Finance a top financial pick, citing 26–27% growth guidance and expected return on assets above 4.1%. It set a ₹1,200 target, citing scope for valuation catch-up.
